6819736826.description:
Play your music on a real-feeling cassette deck. Every album and playlist in your library becomes a tape — pick one, drop it in, press PLAY.

One purchase. No subscription, no ads, no account.

PICK A TAPE
• Your albums and playlists stack up as cassettes, split into side A and side B like a real C-60
• Tap a tape to pull it from the stack, double-tap to load it and start playing
• Every tape remembers exactly where you stopped — eject it, come back later, carry on

REAL KEYS
• PLAY and PAUSE latch down like the real thing, STOP releases them
• Hold FF or REW to cue through the song, double-tap to jump to the next one
• Flick the SIDE switch to turn the tape over
• Reels turn at the right speed: the smaller pack spins faster as the tape runs
• Mechanical clicks and clunks (turn them off any time)

11 DECKS, 1950s TO 2000s
• A wooden 1950s console with a glowing dial and a magic-eye lamp
• A 1960s portable with one lever for rewind and fast-forward
• A 70s deck with VU needles, an 80s silver deck, a 90s auto-reverse player, a 2000s personal stereo
• Car stereo, boombox, studio deck with working ±10% pitch, pocket recorder with two speeds, and a VFD deck
• Each one has its own controls, not just a new color

MADE FOR iPHONE, iPHONE DUO AND iPAD
• The whole screen is the deck — the cassette stands upright and fills the window
• iPhone Duo: folded, the outer screen is the deck. Unfold it and your tapes stand on a shelf beside the deck, spines out — pull one on the left, play it on the right
• Lock Screen and Control Center controls, plays in the background
• Portrait and landscape

Tapewind plays songs from your Music library: music you bought and songs you added from Apple Music (an Apple Music subscription is needed for those). Your music and library never leave your device; Tapewind only sends anonymous usage statistics (no account, no ads, no tracking).

Questions or ideas? Visit tapewind.siamclaw.com/support — we read everything.

6774040750.description:
Tidying up your photo library is exhausting. Let AlbumBee do it for you.

Thousands of photos, hundreds of videos, years of pile-up — your iPhone keeps warning "Storage Almost Full," but in Photos you can't tell what to delete, what to fix, or what you forgot long ago. AlbumBee sorts it all out in one place. A few taps, a few minutes, and you've freed gigabytes.

WHAT IT DOES FOR YOU
• Largest Files First — sorted big-to-small so the storage hogs are obvious. Swipe-delete or multi-select; freeing several GB in 30 seconds is routine.
• Full RAW Pipeline — drop the RAW half of a RAW+JPG pair, or transcode a solo RAW to HEIF (~1/10 the size). Two-phase safety — nothing gets lost.
• Video HEVC Compression — re-encode H.264 to HEVC; quality stays, size routinely drops by half or more. Per-video or batch.
• Burst Grouping — fast bursts auto-grouped to compare side by side, keep the best, drop the rest.
• Screenshot Cleanup — every screenshot in one place, bucketed by month for bulk clearing.
• Location Map & 3D Heatmap — your geotagged photos on a map with 3D heat-pillars; where you've been stands out at a glance.
• Trip Recovery — strings one outing's photos into a "trip," replays the route, and surfaces the trips you forgot.
• Bulk Location Backfill — use located photos from the same time window as anchors to fill in missing coordinates.
• Time Analytics — counts and storage by day / month / year, surfacing your heaviest pile-up days.

PEACE OF MIND
• 100% on-device: all scanning, compression, and transcoding happen on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
• No login, no account, no cloud.
• Never deletes behind your back: you decide every deletion,  and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days.

Reclaiming space shouldn't be a chore. Let AlbumBee tidy your library — light, fast, and entirely yours.

Your next task, right where you need it.

SimpleToDo brings your to-do lists, calendar and priorities together, with interactive widgets that keep them in sight. Plan a workday, stay on top of classes or remember the groceries, then check things off as you go.

DO MORE FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
Choose widgets for task lists, today's to-dos, weekly and monthly calendars, and your priority matrix. Complete tasks directly in supported widgets. Keep essentials on your Lock Screen and open frequently used features from Control Center.

WORKS WITH APPLE REMINDERS
Keep using Siri and Apple Reminders. Enable the connection to see your dated Apple reminders alongside your tasks in SimpleToDo's calendar and supported widgets. Mark a reminder complete here and the change is reflected in Apple Reminders. Continue creating and editing those reminders in Apple's app or with Siri.

SEE YOUR WEEK. CHOOSE WHAT MATTERS.
Organize work, study and everyday life with tags. Plan ahead in weekly and monthly calendar views, then use the Eisenhower matrix to sort tasks by urgency and importance.

CAPTURE PLANS IN YOUR OWN WORDS
Type an English phrase such as "tomorrow gym at 7pm" to turn a thought into a task with a reminder. Set recurring tasks for routines and regular commitments.

REMINDERS ON YOUR TERMS
Choose when you want to be reminded. For tasks that need extra attention, you can enable persistent reminders individually. Repeated notifications are optional.

CHECK IN FROM YOUR WRIST
View and complete tasks on Apple Watch. On supported iPhones, Live Activities keep tasks and progress visible at a glance.

MAKE ROOM TO REFLECT
Write daily and weekly reflections, revisit your progress, and make your workspace feel like yours with themes, custom backgrounds and widget styles.

START WITHOUT A SEPARATE ACCOUNT
No SimpleToDo account to create. Your tasks are stored on your device, with optional iCloud sync to keep them up to date across your iPhone and iPad.

1195301998.description:
Numerology is a refined and intuitive tool designed to explore the energetic meaning behind names, words, numbers, and dates.

The app is based on two ancient systems — Tibetan and Vedic numerology — allowing you to switch between them at any time. Each system offers its own perspective, symbolism, and interpretation, giving depth and contrast to every calculation.

How it works
Enter a name, word, or number, or use the Today button to calculate the energy of the current date.

The app shows:
• The final numerology number
• The numeric value of each word, clearly displayed so you can follow how the result is formed
• A symbolic image representing the number
• Core meanings based on the selected system

You can enable or disable master numbers (11–44) to suit your preferred method of calculation.

Deeper insight

Each number includes:
• Clear explanations for Tibetan or Vedic numerology
• Associations with Astrology and Tarot
• Optional links to online references for further exploration

Using the More Info view, you can explore detailed interpretations such as:
Essence Summary, Inner Motivation, Outer Expression, Strength Pattern, Stress Pattern, and Growth Note — separately for Tibetan and Vedic systems.

Designed for clarity
The interface is clean, fast, and distraction-free. All information is presented visually and textually in a balanced way, making the app suitable for both quick insights and deeper reflection.

Numerology does not predict — it reveals patterns.

This app is designed to help you recognize them.

6761135453.description:
Your Apple Calendar, organized by what matters.

Horizon reads the events you already have in Apple Calendar, sorts them into categories like Work, Health, Family and Travel, and puts the important ones where you'll see them.

There's no new calendar to keep up and no account to create. Allow calendar access and Horizon does the rest, on your device.

SIX LANGUAGES
Use Horizon in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian or Simplified Chinese. Your events can be in any of the six, too, and holidays and birthdays are recognized in your language.

SMART CATEGORIES
Horizon's AI sorts every event into one of 19 categories, and it learns every time you correct it. Make your own categories, and Horizon shows you which events they'd pick up before you add them.

QUICK ADD
Tap + and type it the way you'd say it: "Lunch with Priya Friday at noon" or "Soccer every Saturday at 9 at Marina Green". Horizon works out the day, the time, how long, where and how often, and shows you the event before you add it. Or tap any free time to add something right there.

A DASHBOARD THAT STARTS WITH TODAY
The Today card shows the weather and what's on now or next. Each event tells you where you're going or which call you're joining. Birthdays, holidays and trips sit above your day, so what you have to get to comes first. Browse by category, switch to the month, or turn your iPhone sideways for the week.

DAILY & WEEKLY BRIEFINGS
The Daily Briefing gives you the shape of your day: how much is on, when you're done and where your free time is. The Weekly Briefing shows your busiest days and anything that clashes, and Life Patterns shows where your time really goes.

WEEKLY GOALS
At least 3 workouts a week, or at most 20 hours of Work. Set a goal on any category and watch it fill as the week goes.

WATCHLIST
Count down to what you're looking forward to: a trip, a birthday, a concert. As it gets close, the countdown moves to your Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island, with milestones a month, a week and a day out.

FIND FREE TIME
Need an hour for the gym? Horizon finds the best openings in the hours you choose. Tap one to book it.

INVITATIONS & OVERLAPS
Every invitation waiting for a reply is in one list, with a note when it clashes with plans you've already made. Turn on Keep Until Answered and they stay out of your day until you reply.

SIRI, SHORTCUTS & FOCUS
Ask "What's on my Horizon today?" or "When am I free this week in Horizon?" Shortcuts, Control Center and the Action button are ready to go, and Focus filters show only the categories that fit.

WIDGETS
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for your next events, your day, your week and your Watchlist.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT FIT YOUR DAY
Choose how early each kind of event notifies you: a week ahead for a trip, the morning of for a birthday, 30 minutes before a meeting. Everything about your day arrives together at your Morning Time, in one notification. Reminders notify you when they're due, and if something already has its own alert, Horizon stays quiet.

BUILT ON APPLE CALENDAR
Horizon works with every calendar in Apple Calendar: iCloud, Google, Exchange, Outlook and CalDAV. The same meeting on two calendars shows up once.

IPHONE, IPAD, IPHONE DUO & APPLE WATCH
A side-by-side layout on iPad, a planner across both screens of iPhone Duo, and your day and your Watchlist on Apple Watch.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Categorizing happens entirely on your device. Your events never go to a server, and there's no account and no tracking. Your categories and settings follow you to your other devices through your own iCloud account.

6834076393.description:
Most screen time tools count minutes. Minutes say nothing about whether the time was worth it.

Good Terms puts a five-second check-in in front of the apps you choose to limit. Before you go in, it asks how you feel and what you are looking for. If you are still there when your time runs out, it asks how you feel now, and whether you found it.

Over time you see which sessions leave you better off and which leave you worse, in your own data.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose the apps you want a pause in front of: two for free, or any number and whole categories with Plus.
• Open one and you get a check-in: a mood from Low to Great, and what you are hoping to find.
• Unlock just that app for 5, 15 or 30 minutes.
• Still there when time is up? One more question: how do you feel now?

INSIGHTS FROM YOUR OWN SESSIONS
• Which apps lift your mood and which drain it.
• A grid of every app by time of day, so you can see that the late-night scroll is the one that costs you.
• How often you found what you came for.
• A one-line reminder at each check-in, drawn from your most recent sessions: "Your last 18 sessions here at this time of day ended 1.9 lower on average."
• Nothing is shown until it rests on at least 10 completed sessions.

GENTLE OR FIRM
• Gentle: you can always get in after a check-in, and you can skip it.
• Firm: a daily budget you set in advance, no skipping, and one emergency pass a week.

KIND, NOT STRICT
Good Terms asks and reflects back. It never scolds, and every limit is one you set and can change.

A SKY THAT FOLLOWS YOUR DAY
The app is a paper landscape that changes with the clock: a morning sun, a clear midday, a dusky evening and a night sky. Your mood moves the sun.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Your check-ins are stored on your device. Nothing is sent to us.
• If you join a family, only your weekly totals are shared, through your own iCloud.
• Delete your check-in history at any time, in Limits.
• Good Terms uses Apple's Screen Time to lock the apps you choose. It never sees what you do inside any app.

FOR FAMILIES
• Set Good Terms up on a child's phone with a parent's approval, and keep the limits behind a parent code.
• Together shows each person's week: minutes unlocked, and how often they moved on when time ran out. A parent's numbers are there too.
• Send a cheer when someone does well.
• Moods stay private unless someone chooses to share theirs.

GOOD TERMS PLUS
Good Terms is free for two apps. Plus covers as many apps as you like and whole categories, lets you start a family, and shows each other's week and cheers. One purchase covers your Family Sharing group. Monthly, yearly or a one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew until cancelled in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://hirocloud.com/good-terms/privacy

Good Terms is not a medical product and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Requires iOS 26 or later and Screen Time access.

Ringo brings the classic water-ring toy to your iPhone and iPad. Press the two water jets to lift colourful hoops, steer them through the current, then let them settle over the pegs. A gentle correction can make all the difference.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Play the first 30 Classic tides free. Unlock all 2,000 tides across 80 chapters with Ringo Pro, an optional one-time purchase. • Quick Sets: three short rounds with a choice of focus.
• Time Attack: land as many rings as you can in 60 seconds.
• Zen: keep the rings flowing without a clock.
• Precision: twelve trials with a limited number of bursts.
• Daily Tide: a shared daily puzzle with your best saved on this device.

Choose Bubble Poles, Hover Pods or Crystal Spires. Enjoy underwater scenery, water sounds and haptic feedback. Turn on optional tilt and shake controls, or play entirely with the two buttons.

No ads. No subscription. No app account required. Play offline, with progress and preferences saved on each device. An internet connection is needed to purchase, restore or redeem Ringo Pro. Progress does not sync between devices.

Made for iPhone and iPad, with portrait and landscape play on iPad.

Press, steer, release — and watch the rings find their place.

Learn useful Mandarin from English, or practise English with Mandarin support. Ni Hao Bolo brings a small everyday library, simple flash cards and English Chinese translation together in one calm app.

START WITH EVERYDAY LANGUAGE
Explore words and phrases across practical topics: question words, first words, numbers, meeting people, food and shopping, time and places, and conversation help. Search in English, Chinese or Pinyin.

READ IN THE WAY THAT SUITS YOU
Choose Chinese characters with Pinyin, characters only with Pinyin available to reveal, or Pinyin only. Optional tone colours help distinguish written tones. Hear words and phrases using available system voices, with adjustable speaking speed.

PRACTISE WITHOUT PRESSURE
Reveal an answer, choose Known or Practise again, and undo a choice whenever needed. Today’s Recall brings missed cards and due reviews together. Random 15 offers a short mixed round. There are no streaks, leaderboards or mastery scores.

TRANSLATE BEYOND THE LIBRARY
Type, paste or speak English or Mandarin. Copy a result, show it full screen, see a Pinyin reading aid and revisit recent translations in local history. Automatic translations and Pinyin readings can need checking.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose Jade Tea or Apricot, follow your device’s appearance or select Light or Dark, and adjust reading and audio preferences. Add the Say it today Home Screen widget for a daily phrase.

Learning text, flash cards and saved choices work offline. Translation and audio depend on the required system assets being available. No account, advertising or tracking. Learning choices and translation history stay on your device.

You can also write your own notification text, like “My parcel is on the way”, so only you know what it means. No cringy tips, no weird messages, no pushy upgrade prompts. 6751436384.description:
Your cycle, logged deeply with details. Owned completely.

Petals is a private period tracker that keeps your data on your phone, ALWAYS. No internet needed. No account. No one can see your information, ever.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR PHONE.
